verdicts.explanation: The paper reports the field-driven MD estimate for amorphous Li0.9NbO0.9Cl4.1 as 6.8 ± 0.7 mS/cm at 300 K, computed in this work from its own simulations, so the computational origin and the 26.85 °C conversion are correct. The secondary fields are null, which is consistent with the paper.

The zero-field Einstein-Helfand estimate for the same glass is reported in this paper as σ = 7±5 mS/cm at 300 K, from the authors' own MD, so the value, uncertainty, temperature and computational origin all check out. The secondary fields are null, as the paper gives none.
